active.description: False for any bad, expired or revoked token

roles.description: Role codes, read fresh rather than echoed from the token

permissions.description: Permission codes. Complete — unlike the token claim, this is not dropped when it is large, because a JSON body has no header budget.

active.description: Of those, the ones that can still sign in

inactive.description: Of those, the ones that cannot

nikOwnerId.description: The userId already holding this NIK, or null if free

address.description: The person’s home address. Written in the same transaction as the profile, because this service owns both — hr-service and student-service read it back, they do not keep their own copy.

passwordHash.description: Already bcrypt-hashed by the caller. Never a plaintext password.

userIds.description: User IDs to resolve, up to 200 at a time.

avatarStorageKey.description: Object storage key. Null when no avatar has been uploaded.

isPrimary.description: At most one address per person carries this. Setting it clears the flag on the others.

data.description: One entry per user id that has a profile. A user with no profile is absent, not empty.

storageKey.description: Object key in the bucket. Render the photo from `avatarUrl` instead; this is here for a caller that resolves keys itself.

identifier.description: The sign-in identifier on the account behind this profile.

avatarUrl.description: A presigned GET URL for the photo, valid for S3_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRY_SECONDS. Null when there is no photo, or when object storage is not configured.

religionId.description: From GET /religions. Refused when the id is unknown.

bloodTypeId.description: From GET /blood-types. Refused when the id is unknown.

code.description: Kemendagri code. Two digits for a province, and one more dotted segment per level below it.

module.description: The module category of the permission

app.description: Which application this permission belongs to. Computed from the module, not stored: it is a fact about where the code lives. Not derivable from the code name — four presence modules carry no `presence-` prefix.

isSystem.description: Whether the role is a system reserved role

permissionIds.description: IDs of permissions to grant to this role
IDs of permissions to grant. When provided, replaces the full set.

userId.description: The User ID to assign/remove role for

permissionId.description: The Permission ID to assign/remove for the role

userId.description: The User ID owner of this session

userAgent.description: The user agent of the client browser

ipAddress.description: The IP address of the client device

since.description: Of those, the ones written in the last 24 hours

userId.description: The User ID who triggered the action

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude. Null when no pin has been recorded.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude. Null when no pin has been recorded.
